cohort: 12,306 women who gave birth to a singleton neonate between 2012 and 2020 at a tertiary medical center
finding: Lateral placentation was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and cesarean delivery compared to central placentation.
mod_finding: Lateral placenta was associated with risk of current cesarean delivery (aOR, 1.22; 95% CI, 1.02-1.47).
